examples.label: Validation message under a sign-up email field
examples.source: <.component component_name="chelekom-text-field" site="Global" id="signup-email-field" name="user[email]" label="Email address" placeholder="you@example.com" value="jane@" /> <.component component_name="chelekom-error" site="Global">Please enter a valid email address

examples.label: Two server-side errors stacked above a checkout form
examples.source: <.component component_name="chelekom-error" site="Global">Your card was declined. Try a different card, or contact your bank and retry. <.component component_name="chelekom-error" site="Global">The billing postcode does not match the one your bank has on file.
